$comment: REGISTRY TRUTH — the versions actually published to npm, maintained by hand at publish time (refresh with `npm view <pkg> dist-tags --json` and commit alongside the doc/site change). Two readers, neither of which ever hits the network: the spec-site build (site/src/registry-truth.ts) refuses to print a published-version string absent from this manifest, and `npm run docs:check` (scripts/docs-numbers-check.mjs) fails any doc line claiming a package@version is published that this manifest does not record. The source tree's package.json versions are release candidates that may never have been published; printing them as published is the defect this file exists to prevent.
